mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% as of the decision point indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that sustains consumer spending growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust economic activity that accelerates corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the market becomes vulnerable to negative returns as the Federal Reserve initiates rate hikes to counter inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1500 thousand units indicate strong residential construction activity that drives consumer spending growth and corporate revenue expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 150,000 jobs per month signals sustained labor market strength that increases disposable income and retail sales, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages reflect robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), industrial production above 105 (INDPRO > 105) indicates overcapacity and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105 in a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%).
